description: A side panel for details and secondary tasks, that can open another beside it.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: Drawer opens a side panel over the page to show details or a secondary task without leaving it. A drawer can open another one beside it.
whenToUseItems: Details of an item of the page, keeping the page in view.
A drill-down: a detail that opens a deeper detail beside it.
whenNotToUseItems: For a decision that blocks the page, use [Modal](docs:components-modal--docs).
For a long task with its own steps, use a new screen.
For more than three levels, rethink the flow: the stack keeps three.

formatting.title: Formatting
formatting.layoutText: The stack adapts to the window width.
layoutRows: 1198px and above|Up to 3|The ones behind are dimmed.
576px to 1197px|Up to 2|Narrowing with 3 open keeps the first and the top.
Below 576px|1|Only the top shows, with a back arrow.

rows: 1|Close bar|Yes|Close button, or back arrow on mobile.

content.title: Content
content.text: Each drawer has one subject, named in the title.
writingItems: Name the subject in the title, not the action.
Open the next drawer from a list item with a chevron, not from a button.
content.nextDo: Open the next drawer from a list item with a chevron.
content.nextDont: Do not open the next drawer from a button.

behaviors.title: Behaviors
behaviors.text: The stack is one per page and keeps the order the drawers opened in.
rows: Open from the top drawer|Opens beside it; at the limit it replaces the top.
Click a dimmed drawer|Goes back to it and closes the ones after it.
Close a drawer|Closes it and the ones after it.
Narrow the window|Keeps the first and the top.
Back arrow (mobile)|Goes back to the previous drawer.

modal.title: Modal
modal.text: Use Modal for a decision that blocks the page.

listAction.title: List Action
listAction.text: Use List Action with a chevron to open the next drawer.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
rows: Close button|Enter or Space closes the drawer.
Dimmed drawer|Its content is inert; Enter on it goes back to it.
Back arrow|Enter or Space goes back to the previous drawer.

development.title: Development considerations
items: **Use the stack hook.** `useDrawerStack` sets dim, focus and the inert content.
**Give each drawer a title.** It names the panel for screen readers.
